standard_prerequisites: the Separation axiom schema of Z
the extensional description of the intersection as the set of elements shared by all members
core_obligations: Prove that if A is non-empty then the intersection of A, i.e. the set of x belonging to every member of A, exists
proof_roadmap: Pick c in A; then an element lies in every member of A exactly when it lies in c and in every member of A
So the intersection equals {x in c : x in every member of A}, which exists by Separation applied to c
difficulty_reason: A one-line Separation application; the only care is using non-emptiness to bound the comprehension with a pre-existing set.
